criteria.requirement: Explicit callable inventory for real cold ROOT and CONTRACT child, without promoting null configuration to model readiness.
criteria.decision: Inventory is taken from exact native AIAgent objects through the actual constructor-mode readable sets; native __getattribute__ denies all other names. Public callable sets are close for ROOT and close/run_contract for CHILD; stock/unknown surface denials are exact. Exact tuple types, zero tools/toolsets and provider/model None are required. BoundContractTools exposes read_input/pure_action as an ephemeral, unregistered scope, not a new model-facing registration. This proves the finite constructor-mode surface only, not stock plugin/model-facing readiness.

criteria.requirement: Trusted root/child identity or explicit refusal before domain access; no goal/FIFO association.
criteria.decision: Observer captures original staged real parent/child and checks binding native IDs, child session and parent session against the retained mapping. Independent fresh cases change root session or child session before actual release. Native root and whole-stage guards deny before run_contract/read/PURE; exact exception and unchanged staged/no-result state are required. Refusal is the inert H05 alternative, not a claim of successful live compression. Unaffected batch/attempt and pre-access persistence evidence remains reusable at its accepted scope.

criteria.requirement: Guard False or exception must not authorize read/PURE or usable final result.
criteria.decision: Negative cases replace only the existing trusted service guard, preserving real constructor/release/read/PURE consumer code. False and exception reach run_contract but precede BoundContractTools method-material unpacking and all domain read/PURE. Oracle requires zero _read_bound_input/run_handler, no scope, no approval/final/receipt/artifact, exact refusal, committed binding plus failed/indeterminate/closed and no result. Installed-domain branch requires TASK_INDETERMINATE, no results/checks/inbox, receive-only refusal and unchanged census/readback on retry/reconcile. Positive requires the same channel to observe one real read, two PURE handlers and native SUCCEEDED, preventing always-deny credit.

criteria.requirement: Reuse observer/consumer/selector, no new RPC, grant, native overlay or model/source artifact.
criteria.decision: Changes stay in existing test and fixed selector. H04 attachment is finite/opt-in, uses the existing stock sitecustomize/monitoring route, and leaves ordinary batch2 unchanged. Native callback filtering checks exact file/qualname/code object. Early return still reaches shared owner cleanup and the strict settled observation oracle in finally; PASS is not placed after an unreachable return. No product RPC, model registration, native patch or grant was added. Stage byte assertion preserves, rather than widens, the original cap.

criteria.requirement: New final API-only current reader must be pinned and fully match ROOT/export/wheel/installed; historical reader remains immutable and must refuse as current.
criteria.decision: Required expected_sha256 pins the whole descriptor before origin execution. Commit is exact-format provenance, not a replacement for byte authority. Full non-bytecode path sets and every byte must agree across all four projections; additive model_protocol is not exempted and no hardcoded 88-file escape remains. Existing descriptor/wheel/member/expanded/origin bounds and no-follow/ownership/material controls remain. Real unchanged old descriptor is rejected against actual current ROOT with zero origin calls. New positive SOURCE control substitutes the installed-origin subprocess explicitly and is not installed acceptance.

criteria.decision: H04_READER and H04_READER_SHA are independently unbound; no fallback to the historical reader. H04_REVIEWED/BATCH2_REVIEWED/STARTUP_REVIEWED remain None. Ambient review authority is removed; a CLI flag alone cannot authorize execution. Fixed selector targets the real existing runner and exact source hash. Template keeps offline/frozen/hash-required copy dependencies and API-only wheel/origin; no OCI/native branch is run. Final frozen commit/source manifest/descriptor hashes must be retained by parent. Actual Python -c payloads at template command indices 3 and 12 parse; pytest -c at index 13 is configuration, not Python code. Recipe remains unexecuted.
